Record Class HeldRecord.Unmet

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.HeldRecord.Unmet
Record Components:
diagnosis - what the shape of the gap indicates
topic - the topic the missing cause sits on
partition - its partition
claimedOffset - the offset claimed, or -1 for a sequence claim
localFrontier - the highest offset delivered locally on that channel and the watermark an offset claim is measured against, or -1 for none
localPosition - the local consumer position, below which everything has been fetched here or consumer-skipped
sender - the claimed record's sender identity, or null for an offset claim
claimedSequence - the send sequence claimed, or -1 for an offset claim
deliveredSequence - the highest sequence delivered locally from that sender on that channel, or -1 if none has been
Enclosing class:
HeldRecord
public static record HeldRecord.Unmet(HeldRecord.Diagnosis diagnosis, String topic, int partition, long claimedOffset, long localFrontier, long localPosition, String sender, long claimedSequence, long deliveredSequence) extends Record
Describes one cause a held record is still waiting for, with the local watermarks that show the gap.

A claim is either an offset claim, with claimedOffset set and sender null, or a sequence claim, with sender and claimedSequence set. Those are the two claim kinds of the wire format.
